name: Backup failed or stale
description: Backup age (grokbot.backup.age_hours) stayed above 25 hours for 1 hour 15 minutes.
programText:
age = data('grokbot.backup.age_hours').publish('signal')
detect(when(age > 25, lasting='1h15m')).publish('Backup failed or stale')

rules.parameterizedSubject: Grok Bot backup failed or stale
rules.parameterizedBody: The nightly backup failed or is older than 25h. Fix: read the newest backup log and rerun the backup routine.
